events.text: Whitney was born in Northampton , Massachusetts.

events.text: Whitney graduated from Williams College in 1845.

events.quote: Whitney entered Williams College at fifteen , graduating in 1845 .

events.text: Whitney assisted his older brother Josiah Whitney on a geological survey of the Lake Superior region in 1849.
events.subject: self
events.object: geological survey of the Lake Superior region
events.quote: assisted his older brother Josiah Whitney on a geological survey of the Lake Superior region in 1849

events.text: On this expedition, Whitney began the study of Sanskrit in his leisure hours.
events.subject: self
events.quote: On this expedition , he began the study of Sanskrit in his leisure hours .

events.text: Whitney left the United States to study philology and Sanskrit in Germany in 1850.
events.subject: self
events.quote: In 1850 , Whitney left the United States to study philology , and especially Sanskrit , in Germany .

events.text: Whitney began a major life project, preparation of an edition and translation of the Atharva-veda, during his time in Germany.
events.subject: self
events.object: edition and translation of the Atharva-veda
events.quote: It was during his time in Germany that Whitney began a major life project , preparation of an edition and translation of the Atharva-veda .

events.text: Whitney received his doctoral degree from the University of Breslau in 1861.
